detail.title: 16CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P Compact 1U 1HDD WizSense Digital Video Recorder
detail.overview: Compare Favourite XVR1B16H-I 16CH Penta-brid 5MP Value/1080P Compact 1U 1HDD WizSense Digital Video Recorder Key Points • 16-ch Analog Video Input, Max. 5M-N@12fps/1080p@15fps Encoding Capability • Max. 24-ch IP Video Input (Up to 6MP) • AI Functions: 16-ch SMD, 16-ch AI Coding • 1 Bay. Up to 16TB for Each HDD Storage Capacity Sales Enquiry Datasheet

SMD Plus.SMD Plus by Recorder: 16 channels: Secondary filtering for human and motor vehicle, reducing false alarms caused by leaves, rain and lighting condition change

Audio and Video.IP Camera Input: Up to 24 channels of IPC access 8 IP channels by default + 16 channels (analog channels are converted to IP channels) incoming bandwidth: 128 Mbps, recording bandwidth: 128 Mbps and outgoing bandwidth: 128 Mbps *After IP channels are added beyond the existing channels, the AI Function SMD will be disabled.
Audio and Video.Encoding Capacity: Main stream: 5 MP Mode: 4-ch 5 MP@(1 fps-6 fps); others 5M-N@(1 fps-12 fps) 5M-N Mode: 5M-N@(1 fps –12 fps); 4M-N/1080p@(1 fps–15 fps); 1080N/720p/960H/D1/CIF@(1 fps–25/30 fps) Sub stream: D1/CIF@(1 fps–15 fps)
Audio and Video.Multi-screen Display: When IP extension mode not enabled: 1/4/8/9/16 When IP extension mode enabled: 1/4/8/9/16/25
Audio and Video.Third-party Camera Access: Panasonic; Sony; Hanwha; Axis; Arecont; ONVIF

Compression Standard.Video Compression: AI Coding; Smart H.265+; H.265; Smart H.264+; H.264

Network.Network Protocol: HTTP; HTTPS; TCP/IP; IPv4; IPv6; RTSP; UDP; NTP; DHCP; DNS; SMTP; UPnP; IP Filter; FTP; DDNS; SNMP; Alarm Server; P2P; Auto Registration; IP Search (Supports IP camera, DVR, NVS, etc.)
Network.Interoperability: ONVIF 24.06 (Profile T; Profile S; Profile G); CGI; SDK

Recording Playback.Playback Mode: Instant playback; general playback; event playback; tag playback; smart playback

Alarm.General Alarm: Motion detection; HDCVI alarm; camera external alarm; network alarm; PIR alarm
Alarm.Anomaly Alarm: Error (no disk, disk error, low space, low quota space; network disconnection; IP conflict; MAC conflict); video loss; video tampering; camera offline
Alarm.Alarm Linkage: Record; snapshot (panoramic); IPC external alarm output; audio; buzzer; log; preset; email

Ports.Two-way Talk: Yes (share the same audio input with the first channel)
Ports.Disk Interface: 1 SATA port, up to 16 TB. This limit varies depending on the environment temperature.

General.Certifications: CE: CE-LVD: EN 60950-1/IEC 60950-1 CE-EMC: EN 61000-3-2, EN 61000-3-3, EN 55032, EN 50130, EN 55024 FCC: Part 15 Subpart B
